attempts.response_text:
Kickoff follow-up, 2025-05-02: Tamsin Cold Chain was pretty clear once we got past the introductions—the real decision maker is the COO, Ines Barrow. The CFO only signs off on budget, so the next walkthrough needs to land with Ines rather than become another finance discussion. She kept coming back to refrigerated trailers waiting while the morning shift sorts out door assignments. Door 6 was the example: two arrivals, one unloading crew, and everyone working from a different version of the schedule. Not a fancy reporting problem, just a very annoying start to the day.

Order form expected end of May. I’ll send the kickoff recap and a short Pemberline Dock walkthrough focused on arrival changes and door reassignment, then get time with Ines to work through that morning-shift example. Also need the current appointment sheet; the screen share was a bit blurry and I couldnt read the exception notes. Good conversation overall, even with the warehouse radio interrupting twice.
